scope: Independent local HTTP client for launcher lifetime tests; no installed-client captures or external inference
constraints: Only Go standard-library imports; no proxy implementation imports
The supplied gateway must use HTTP with a literal loopback IP
All prompts, tools, arguments, results and settings are independently chosen synthetic values
The fixture executes no client tool or hook and modifies no user or project file
Observed stdout contains only its owned process ID, local address, runtime path and fixed state
Readiness output is a fixture control, not evidence of actual Claude initialization
Cancellation and finite lifetime are controlled by the product's attached process-group owner
